sentences.l2: 在许多普通家庭里，一场突如其来的大病足以让多年的积蓄化为乌有。
sentences.l1: In many ordinary families, a sudden serious illness is enough to reduce years of savings to nothing.

sentences.l2: 李阿姨的老伴去年被确诊为重症，住院、手术加上长期用药，前后花费近四十万元。
sentences.l1: Aunt Li's husband was diagnosed with a severe illness last year, and with hospitalization, surgery and long-term medication, the total cost was nearly 400,000 yuan.

sentences.l2: 虽然医保为他们报销了大部分住院费用，但进口药、特护病房以及院外购买的药品并不在目录之内，只能全部自费，这部分开销最终仍压得全家喘不过气。
sentences.l1: Although medical insurance reimbursed most of their hospitalization costs, imported drugs, special-care wards and drugs bought outside the hospital are not on the list, and had to be paid for entirely out of pocket, and this portion of the expense still left the whole family breathless in the end.

sentences.l2: 为了筹措医药费，儿子不得不放弃外地的读研机会，回家找工作。
sentences.l1: To raise money for medical bills, her son had to give up an opportunity to pursue graduate study in another city and come home to find a job.

sentences.l2: 事实上，看病难不仅体现在挂号排队、专家难约，更体现在优质医疗资源过度集中于大城市，偏远地区的患者往往要辗转数小时才能看上专科门诊。
sentences.l1: In fact, the difficulty of seeing a doctor is reflected not only in queuing to register and the difficulty of booking specialists, but even more in the excessive concentration of high-quality medical resources in big cities, so that patients in remote areas often have to travel for hours before they can see a specialist clinic.

sentences.l2: 对普通家庭而言，医保是必需的安全网；只有把大病保障、异地结算与基层医疗真正落到实处，这张网才不会在最需要的时候出现漏洞。
sentences.l1: For ordinary families, medical insurance is a necessary safety net; only when serious-illness coverage, cross-region settlement and primary care are truly put into practice will this net not develop holes just when it is needed most.
